lede: Liberty carries the stronger underlying team rating — -0.1 against -6.4, a 6.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Coastal Carolina -0.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Coastal Carolina winning 51% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is depth, where Liberty leads Coastal Carolina by 126 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
